svg.title: Patch test for glitter on the inner forearm, medium skin. 1: dab a coin-sized spot of glitter base, and a second spot for a second product. 2: pat cosmetic glitter onto each spot with a fingertip. 3: wear it as long as you would wear a design, then wash it off. Done: check the skin over 24 to 48 hours; no redness, itching or swelling means that product passed.
